const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
pack=.ai/task/repair-w26-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json
window=evidence/quality/repair-window-26-20260923
mkdir -p "$window/orchestration"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r source relative sha bytes; do
  target="$window/orchestration/$relative"
  if [ -e "$target" ]; then
    cmp -s "$source" "$target" || { echo "PACK target differs: $target" >&2; exit 1; }
  else
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
    cp -- "$source" "$target"
  fi
  actual_sha=$(sha256sum "$target" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  actual_bytes=$(stat -c %s "$target")
  [ "$actual_sha" = "$sha" ] || { echo "PACK SHA mismatch: $target" >&2; exit 1; }
  [ "$actual_bytes" = "$bytes" ] || { echo "PACK byte mismatch: $target" >&2; exit 1; }
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source, .relative_destination, .sha256, (.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$pack")
if [ -e "$window/orchestration-pack-manifest.json" ]; then
  cmp -s "$pack" "$window/orchestration-pack-manifest.json" || { echo "manifest target differs" >&2; exit 1; }
else
  cp -- "$pack" "$window/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
fi
candidate=.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window26-20260923-candidate-catalog
while IFS= read -r -d '' source; do
  relative=${source#"$candidate/"}
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$relative")"
  cp -- "$source" "$relative"
done < <(find "$candidate" -type f -print0)
mkdir -p evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations
cp -- .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window26-20260923-migration.json evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/6f8736fb807babfeda9ddd927ffc5958251ddd23bba538dc87f6ee40d6314302.json
mkdir -p "$window/publication"
for name in PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json ADJUDICATION-R0.json ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json; do
  cp -- ".ai/task/repair-w26-20260923/$name" "$window/publication/$name"
done
for name in queue-1.log queue-1-timing.json catalog.log catalog-timing.json migration.json migration-timing.json migration-run.log migration-run-timing.json; do
  cp -- ".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window26-20260923-$name" "$window/publication/$name"
done
printf 'installed_pack_files=%s\n' "$(find "$window/orchestration" -type f | wc -l)"
printf 'installed_publication_files=%s\n' "$(find "$window/publication" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)"",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 30000,
  max_output_tokens: 5000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我按已核验的发布范围精确复制 PACK 快照、候选 catalog/migration 和 publication 附件到获准目标吗？"
});
text(r.output);

    assert src.read_bytes()==dst.read_bytes(), f'catalog literal mismatch: {dst}'
